convert_rlestimator_input_to_edp: convert an RLEstimatorInput log into an EvaluationDataPage with mdp ids, propensities, rewards, and action masks
test_gridworld_sequential_adapter: test the sequential doubly robust OPE estimator by evaluating a target policy on a gridworld environment with noisy model
test_seq2slate_eval_data_page: test slate ranking OPE evaluation using Direct Method, IPS, and Doubly Robust estimators on synthetic seq2slate logs
run_ope_estimators_on_edp: run OPEstimatorAdapter with DM, IPS, DR, Switch, and SwitchDR estimators on an EvaluationDataPage to get CPE estimates
create_edp_from_tensors_seq2slate: create an EvaluationDataPage from seq2slate tensors using a transformer net and reward net with eval greedy flag
